title: A Control Barrier Function Based Visual Servoing Framework for Safe Operation of UAVs in GNSS Denied Settings using Fiducial Markers
authors: A. Lynch; C. Lyu; J. Buzzatto; S. Heshmati-Alamdari; M. Liarokapis
